planets.name: EPIC 201170410 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of EPIC 201170410 with a 6.8-day year, found in 2020.

text.card: EPIC 201170410 b was found in 2020 by K2 as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around EPIC 201170410. Its orbit and size follow del Ser & Fors 2020's fit, the archive's default.
